DESCRIPTION:
Versatile and economical controller may be programmed to turn equipment on and off at any minute of any day. A fail-safe memory permits programming 14 different switchings per day. They may be allocated over four separate weekly programs for up to 196 switchings per week. Random function automatically turns the controller on and off at random intervals.

Schedule an entire week with the press of a few buttons. Switches located on the front panel control the entire operation. The Outlet Controller will turn equipment on and off in intervals as short as 1 minute or as long as 168 hours. Turn an instrument on today and off a week later.

A manual override permits equipment to be switched on or off without disturbing the program. Program and clock times are maintained by a backup battery in the event of an electrical outage. Brilliant, 1/2-inch-high LCD shows the time-of-day, day, and event number.

To assure accuracy an individually serial-numbered Traceable Certificate is provided from Control Companys ISO/IEC 17025 (1750.01) calibration laboratory accredited by A2LA. It indicates traceability to standards provided by NIST (National Institute of Standards and Technology). CSA-and NTRL-C rated unit controls equipment to 125 VAC, 50/60 Hz, 15 amps, 1850 watts with a timing accuracy of 0.01%. Supplied with two 1.5-volt batteries. High-impact ABS plastic case is 2 x 4 x 3-1/2 inches. Weight is 5-1/2 ounces. Replacement battery Cat. No. 350-18940.

DESCRIPTION:
The Tuttnauer® CSU6H Clean & Simple Ultrasonic Cleaner With Heater use ultrasonically-generated cavitation (the creation of small, implosive bubbles) to clean instruments and equipment of soil and contamination. With a 60 kHz frequency, the Clean & Simple™ Ultrasonics are quieter and gentler than ultrasonics that operate at lower frequencies, while still being quite effective at cleaning. A duration of 0 to 60 minutes can be set for the cleaning cycles of the Tabletop Ultrasonic Machines with the timer dial on the front. Features:
 Uses cavitation of water or cleaning solution to dislodge soil 60 kHz frequency for quiet, powerful cleaning Less aggressive and damaging than other ultrasonics 3-gallon capacity Sized to fit loose instruments or 3 full-size cassettes Timer dial for 0 to 60 minutes per cycle Available with or without heater Vinyl-coated steel exterior resists scratching Stainless steel tank Easy to clean
